Machines available

Our Technology, Machine by Machine

CO2 + Erbium Glass 1550nm

Our go-to for resurfacing. The CO2 laser renews the skin surface while the 1550nm Erbium Glass works deeper, together treating acne and accident scars, pores, texture and fine lines with less downtime than older fractional lasers.

PigmentationMelasmaTanTattoos

Why it matters

Why the Right Machine Makes a Difference

Safety for Indian skin
Brown skin reacts more easily to heat. Modern technologies like picosecond lasers, focused ultrasound and RF microneedling give results with less risk of pigmentation.
Precision
Advanced machines target exact depths and wavelengths, so energy goes where it's needed and nowhere else.
Comfort and less downtime
Newer devices deliver energy faster and more evenly, which means shorter sessions and quicker recovery.
Consistent, measurable results
Medical-grade devices give predictable results that we can repeat and track over time.
Genuine consumables
We use the manufacturer's genuine tips, cartridges and serums, which matters for both safety and results.

Questions

Machines & Technology FAQs

What machines does Facelit use?
Facelit uses the CO2 + Erbium Glass 1550nm laser, PicoCare 450, the original HydraFacial, Ultraformer III HIFU, Vivace MNRF, CM Slim with the Hipex Chair, Candela GentleMax Pro and InMode Optimas.
Are Facelit's machines FDA-approved?
Our machines are US FDA-cleared medical devices from established manufacturers. FDA clearance means a device has been reviewed for safety and effectiveness for specific uses.
Which laser is safe for Indian skin?
Indian skin needs lasers and settings that keep heat and pigmentation risk low. Picosecond lasers like PicoCare 450, and the Nd:YAG wavelength used for hair reduction, are well suited to darker skin, and our doctors adjust every setting to your skin type.
What is the best machine for acne scars?
For acne scars, we most often use the CO2 + Erbium Glass 1550nm laser or Vivace MNRF, sometimes combined with exosomes or PRP. The right choice depends on your scar type and downtime.
What is the best machine for pigmentation and melasma?
PicoCare 450 is our main laser for pigmentation, melasma, tan and tattoos, because its ultra-short pulses break up pigment with very little heat.
Is HIFU the same as Ultraformer III?
HIFU is the technology, and Ultraformer III is the machine we use. It's an advanced HIFU platform with multiple cartridges for different skin depths, from the surface to the SMAS lifting layer.
Which machine is used for laser hair reduction?
We use laser platforms such as the Candela GentleMax Pro and InMode Optimas, choosing the wavelength and settings that suit your skin and hair type.
Does a better machine mean better results?
Good technology matters, but so does who uses it. Our doctors choose the right machine, settings and number of sessions for your skin, which is what gives safe, consistent results.
Where are these machines available?
Our full range of technology is at our flagship Trivandrum clinic, with selected machines at Karunagappally and Guruvayur. Contact us to check availability at your nearest branch.
